thread:
maria-peopleops: Quick heads-up — we're doing a final compliance sweep for SOC2/ISO evidence. Collection closes Thursday 17:00 PT. Please double-check your team's folder in the Evidence Vault and add any missing artifacts. Link: https://redwood.internal/evidence-vault

maria-peopleops: Key ask: label files so auditors can ingest them automatically. Use this pattern: soc2_iso_evidence-<team>-<shortartifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf

sam-engops: Quick clarifying Q: for service account lists, does the CSV need the full principal ARN or is a name+role column okay?

maria-peopleops: Name+role column is fine, but include an export from the provider showing the principal if available. Attach a short note in the upload metadata describing what was redacted.

lina-ml: We've got model eval logs that contain sample customer text. Do we need to redact those before upload?

omar-legal: Yes redact customer-identifiable content. If redaction isn't possible, move the artifact to the secure transfer and note why in the metadata so auditors can request a redacted copy later.

maria-peopleops: Also: privacy attestations — if you haven't completed the annual form, please do it now. Evidence can be the LMS CSV export or the attestation form PDF. Label those files with `attestation` in the filename.

AuditBot: Automated summary will post Wed 24h before close with a per-team missing-items list. Teams with outstanding items will receive a follow-up ping.

sam-engops: Uploaded service account CSV and added myself as owner. Marked thread with :white_check_mark:.

maria-peopleops: Thanks Sam. Two final tips: 1) for large diagrams (>30MB) use the secure link on the upload page, 2) if you need help redacting or converting formats, drop files in #help-compliance and tag me.

maria-peopleops: Auditors start sampling Friday morning. If you can't meet the deadline, tell us asap so we can log an exception request — but aim to avoid that. Appreciate the sprint push, folks. :sparkles:
